1. Use the EXACT entity URIs provided in the schema
2. For multi-hop queries, chain triple patterns
3. Prefer dbp: properties when both dbo:/dbp: are available

6. Generate ONLY the SPARQL query, no explanation

```sparql
PREFIX dbr: <http://dbpedia.org/resource/>
PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/>
PREFIX dbp: <http://dbpedia.org/property/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?film ?director ?deathDate
WHERE {
  VALUES ?film { 
    <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Pacific_Rendezvous> 
    <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Calling_Bulldog_Drummond>
  }
  ?film dbp:director ?director .
  ?director dbp:deathDate ?deathDate .
}
LIMIT 100
```
